name: Royal Enfield Interceptor 650
engine: 648 cc air/oil-cooled SOHC parallel twin, fuel injected
intro: Royal Enfield's 650 twin. Simple and easy to work on. Check the brake caliper recall.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. 2018-2020 Interceptor and Continental GT 650s were in recall 21V045 because road salt can corrode the brake calipers.
A-002.reason: Corroded calipers can drag or lose braking. The repair is free.

K: If the bike was ridden in winter, look closely at the calipers and brake lines for corrosion.

recalls.what: Road salt can corrode the brake calipers.
